observation: Course documentation identifies packaged MemoRizz, custom ERPA and advanced tracks, synthetic fixtures and optional live profiles.
MemAgent local facade recalls, decides, dispatches direct operations and saves turn.
Live MemAgent factory is distinct from the local facade.
MemoRizzMemory provides local recall and remember.
DirectToolbox supplies application-specific capabilities.
ERPAStateGraph uses boundary cache then assemble_context, call_model, dispatch_tools and persist. A hit returns before recall, inference or ordinary persistence.
compile_live_graph constructs separate live graph.
Factories construct OAMP, retrieval and checkpointer for live profile.
BoundarySemanticCache provides response caching.
SemanticLayer defines business meaning and query support.
compare_responses exposes alternative retrieval responses.
Progressive disclosure selects procedure context.
CustomToolbox supplies business and external capability adapters.
Local and live OAMP memory provider classes are distinct.
Action draft, approval and execution are separate operations.
Session end stages and drains promotion queue.
BriefScheduler provides automation.
Local fixed chart and optional E2B paths are separate.
Compose describes configured deployment, not running infrastructure.
Start, resume, decision and inspect endpoints expose workflow lifecycle.
Separate Oracle run and approval store classes.
Supplier tools cover freshness, sanctions, scoring, remediation and report verification.
SandboxedToolExecutor validates registered arguments, derives expected output on host, enforces remote no-egress request, compares output and closes provider.
TotalRecallState and TotalRecallHarness define separate ontology-oriented example.
In-memory and Oracle agent memory manager alternatives.
Research API exposes start, approval, run and snapshots.
MetaHarnessCourse coordinates evaluation demonstration.
Protocol manifest and stable hash identify evaluation configuration.
